svg.text: CORRECTED COLOR PREVIEW · MATCHED TO THE SITE STYLESHEET
The same site, easier to use on smaller screens
Actual warm-white canvas, near-black text and buttons, violet accents, coral verdict details, and existing mobile layout.
One product per row · full-width search
Search stays visible · more room for product details
Tap Search below any time to return to this field.
Companion software is needed for full features.
More horizontal room · no phone bottom navigation
Browse products and check each retailer for current prices and stock.
• Header actions stay compact; search gets its own row.
• Product rows stack vertically so names and controls fit.
• No horizontal page scroll; safe-area space below.
• Same familiar product row, with heart and compare controls.
• Search suggestions stay reachable when the field is focused.
• Wider header and content; phone bottom bar is hidden.
• Category rail remains through 899 px; filter sheet stays within reach.
• At 900 px and wider, the full filter sidebar returns.
• Search is visible without tapping first; bottom Search focuses it.
• Bottom Browse, Search, Saved, Compare, Guides stays safe-area aware.
Warm-white canvas · near-black actions · violet accents
Same logo, type, buttons, category chips, and product rows
Coral verdict details · dark mode keeps its OLED palette
